description: This is a Python source file implementing a speech-to-text service class named GroqSTTService. It inherits from BaseWhisperSTTService and uses the Groq API to transcribe audio data into text. The class includes initialization parameters such as model type, API key, URL, language, prompt, and temperature, and defines an asynchronous method for performing transcription.
